operations.text: 0.3.7 changes the review and QA launch form: the brief is written to a per-ticket file, <scratchDir>/<key>-review-brief.txt (QA: <key>-qa-brief.txt; the plan skill's round file <key>-readiness-round.txt), <key> being the session-state key of 0.3.6, and the wrapper reads it through -BriefFile <path> (PowerShell) / --brief-file <path> (bash), so the command keeps a constant prefix with no pipe in front of it. stdin stays the fallback; a missing, unreadable, empty or whitespace-only brief file, or the flag together with a non-empty stdin, is exit 2 before any paid call. A local allow rule you wrote on the 0.3.6 pipe form (Get-Content ... | & codex-review.ps1 ..., cat ... | bash codex-review.sh ...) stops matching: rewrite it on the new prefix - the payload ships only the blanket allow. The old fixed review-brief.txt / qa-brief.txt / readiness-round.txt files in your scratch directory are no longer read - leftovers for the scratch cleanup's keep-or-move check. The habit guard inside the git-verb hook now denies, for every actor, a pipe into tail / head / Select-Object -First|-Last, a leading cd / chdir / pushd / Set-Location / sl, and git -c <k=v>, each with a hint. This update re-renders the managed CLAUDE.md region, ORCHESTRATOR.md and the Writer agent; the wrappers and the hooks are payload, run from the plugin root.
